Continuous variables were reported as mean ± SD, while categorical variables were presented as counts and percentages.

memory: A study compared hypertension telemonitoring-based service with control on accident and emergency visits costs. Participants monitored BP twice daily for the first week and then weekly. Mean costs were 6.70 (2.24) and 9.74 (2.98), with a difference of -3.04 (−8.87 to 2.47), p=0.286. Clinicians accessed electronic records or contacted patients for changes. memory: A phase II, multicenter, open-label trial compared two treatment arms, with patients treated until progression, toxicity, or withdrawal. Intention-to-treat analysis was used. Patients were blinded to the technique. Specimen retrieval using a homemade lubricated saline bag was feasible and safe, with shorter retrieval time than commercial bags. Tubal size was measured intraoperatively under general anesthesia. Follow-up completion rates differed between groups.

memory: Almonds, rich in monounsaturated fat, fiber, α-tocopherol, and phytochemicals, were studied in CAD patients on statins and lifestyle changes. An almond-enriched diet (ALM) increased plasma α-tocopherol by 10.2% and decreased γ-tocopherol by 16.5% compared to a control diet (CON). The study was double-blinded, conducted in multiple Chinese hospitals, followed GCP, and used simulated JQJT tablets. Anti-diabetic drugs were excluded to avoid blood sugar interference.

memory: A study compared an area-wide, computerised diabetes register with a standard system, assessing frequencies of diabetes appointments, foot checks, dietary advice, and blood pressure recording. The intervention showed higher odds of these outcomes (OR 2.00–2.77). The system aimed to improve care coordination and reduce patient loss to follow-up. Evidence was based on patient-randomised trials with limited economic evaluation. Other studies on genotyping platforms and trial designs were not directly relevant.

memory: - cGMP analysis used GLM with non-genetic covariates. CVD is a major mortality cause in diabetes/metabolic syndrome patients. RELAX trial included genetics sub-study using Sequenom's iPLEX® ADME PGx Panel for SNP genotyping. Hypotension/flushing risk analyzed via logistic regression. HFN sub-study required IRB approval. Continuous variables presented as mean ± SD; categorical as counts/percentages. Diabetes register system developed to address care documentation issues. Intervention practices had higher odds of diabetes appointments, foot checks, dietary advice, and BP recordings. Practices enrolled directly, risking sample size. baPWV measured for arterial stiffness; transmission time calculated based on height. Informed consent obtained; study approved by Korea University Hospital IRB. Grizzles model included treatment, carry-over, and sequential effects as fixed effects. SCOPE trial used telephone/mail follow-up; excluded invalid addresses.
